questions.question: When was the penicillin allergy first recorded, and what evidence or reaction details were documented at that time?
What medications were started, stopped, held or changed around the time of the penicillin allergy documentation?
Were any antibiotics prescribed before or after the penicillin allergy claim, and which ones?
Has any follow-up or verification been done for the reported penicillin allergy (e.g., testing, clarification, or de-labeling)?
What other allergies or reactions are documented in the record besides penicillin?
Are there any outstanding referrals, tests or follow-ups related to allergy assessment or medication safety?
